question: In a certain code language, 'HALMST' is written as 'IZMLTS' and 'GEASTR' is written as 'HDBRUQ'. How will 'TRAILS' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'HALMST' is written as 'IZMLTS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05645d347a1fa07e2daaf78a5da06e55bf316fe060d1c050136e5b7ab2bd7deb.png] 

For, 'GEASTR' is written as 'HDBRUQ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad7bc995a28bb3dacede100adb28068a678a2b811ecd5466d1a680e573725321.png] 

Similarly, for 'TRAILS':

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a392467d18b5229ede2e5ba0db824b06902537661605685642c71b59316a8a68.png] 

So, 'TRAILS' will be coded as '**UQBHMR**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
